body: From the DM-267 review (orchestrator, this run) — fix in the metrics summary and pin: (1) an unsized or empty cohort must be NOT comparable (metricsSummary.ts:374-378 gives every unsized sprint cohort ['unsized'], so unrelated epics compare: Checkout revamp −34.7 vs Search tuning); the cohort is a de-duplicated set, so ticket counts are ignored — include counts; (2) expose the previous entry's epic on `comparison` (or a crossEpic flag) and add a cross-epic reason to INCOMPARABLE (:446-452) when policy/cohort can't vouch for comparability; keep project-wide chronological order. (3) Gaps should carry ticket key and title so the dashboard needs no plan reads; `lowestComponents` should not list a 100.0 component as a gap.
